author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Prepare offline bounded latency and depth-error analysis
details: Add strict private measurement input, conservative latency bounds with median/p95/max, explicit failed-trial counts, sector/distance error and availability summaries, synthetic example and bench collection guide. Keep software command separate from measured physical onset; clock/provenance and physical acceptance remain independent review gates.
validation: 15 focused unit/CLI tests passed on Windows and network-disabled local Linux Python 3.12 Docker. Included example is deliberately synthetic and below the 20-observation requirement. No device, camera, GPIO or motor tests performed.
